description: The plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and epochs for three different categories. The x-axis, labeled "Epochs", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 3, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU score", also has a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to 0.35, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The plot displays three lines: the blue line, representing "Regular members", starts at approximately 0.03 at 0.25 epochs and increases to around 0.17 at 2.75 epochs, with a steady upward trend; the orange line, representing "Members with near-duplicates", begins at about 0.04 at 0.25 epochs and rises sharply to approximately 0.39 at 1.75 epochs, before slightly decreasing to around 0.38 at 2.0 epochs and then continuing to increase; the green line, representing "Held-out data", starts at roughly 0.02 at 0.25 epochs and gradually increases to about 0.15 at 2.75 epochs, with a relatively steady and slow upward trend.
